## Cboe Launches KPI Binary Options, a New Way to Trade the Numbers Behind Earnings


November 24, 2026


- Built for retail access and institutional precision, listed and cleared as SEC-regulated securities options
- More than 100 widely followed company metrics tied to 23 companies
- Products available now on Robinhood and coming soon to Interactive Brokers


CHICAGO


, Nov. 24, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Cboe Global Markets, Inc. (Cboe: CBOE), a leading global markets operator and pioneer in equity and index derivatives, today launched KPI binary options, a new class of listed options tied to company-specific, key performance indicators (KPIs) that companies disclose in their quarterly earnings-related filings. The products give retail and institutional investors the ability to trade a view on a company's reported KPI results directly, independent of the stock price reaction.


KPI contracts tied to 23 public companies are now available to trade. The companies are some of the most traded names in U.S. equities and options markets, and the contracts are tied to metrics companies report each quarter. The universe of KPIs includes Earnings Per Share, Revenue and Net Income, as well as company-specific metrics like Nvidia's Data Center Revenue, Amazon's AWS Revenue, and Tesla's Model 3/Y Production. Each contract will settle at $1.00 if the KPI value satisfies the contract's payout criterion, and $0.00 if it does not. A contract trading at a price of 30 cents would signal a roughly 30% market-implied chance that the KPI clears its threshold.


"Earnings season comes down to a handful of numbers, and many investors and followers of companies already track and have a view on these metrics. Cboe's KPI binary options let investors trade those numbers directly, on the same trusted options infrastructure Cboe has built over more than 50 years," said JJ Kinahan, Senior Vice President, Head of Retail Expansion and Alternative Investment Products at Cboe. "We often hear from investors how trading the stock around earnings can be frustrating, since you can be right on the quarterly metrics only for the shares to move on forward guidance or macro news. This launch gives investors a way to trade on what they know and expect in the current reporting quarter, and is the latest step in our plans to deliver useful hedging and investing tools focused on financial and economic outcomes."


Cboe's KPI binary options are expected to appeal to both retail and institutional investors. For retail investors, the products offer a clear, defined payoff on a company's results, and a buyer's maximum loss is the premium paid. Investors can access the contracts through brokerage accounts they already use, with the same options-approval requirements, standardized disclosures and FINRA oversight that apply to other listed options.


For institutions, the securities options structure could offer an accessible route to these exposures. It also opens strategies no listed equity option can isolate. A fund long a stock into earnings can hedge an EPS miss without paying the volatility premium built into standard equity options. A trading desk can take a view on a single business segment, such as Amazon's AWS revenue, or a relative-value view, such as AMD versus Nvidia data center revenue, separate from either stock's price. Research and quant teams can use KPI option prices as a real-time, market-implied complement to consensus estimates. Cboe's Derivatives Market Intelligence team details these use cases and more in its latest research, "[Corporate KPI Binary Options: A New Way to Trade Earnings](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830193-1&h=366526745&u=https%3A%2F%2Fgo.cboe.com%2Fl%2F77532%2F2026-11-09%2Ffrvmg9%2F77532%2F17942608950uEL0CkA%2FCorporate_KPI_Options_FINAL.pdf&a=Corporate+KPI+Binary+Options%3A+A+New+Way+to+Trade+Earnings) ."


The contracts are now available to Robinhood customers as earnings predictions under its prediction markets hub, and will soon be available to eligible Interactive Brokers customers. Cboe plans to add more brokers and list additional KPI contracts tied to additional public companies, based on client demand.


"The numbers behind a company's quarterly performance matter as much as the earnings call itself. With earnings predictions now available from Cboe, Robinhood customers can trade on those numbers directly and precisely," said Steve Quirk, Chief Brokerage Officer at Robinhood.


"We're pleased to work with Cboe to bring KPI Binary Options to our clients," said Milan Galik, Chief Executive Officer of Interactive Brokers. "These contracts give investors another way to express their views on individual companies, complementing the stocks, options and other instruments they can already trade on our platform."


"We're proud to work with Cboe on the launch of KPI binary options," said Bob Fitzsimmons, EVP, Wedbush. "Markets are moving quickly, and supporting new products from day one takes work well in advance of the first trade. At Wedbush, we built our clearing platform with that kind of readiness in mind so we can support innovation across asset classes."


Cboe will not charge fees on the KPI binary options initially to aid adoption. Robinhood will also offer the products initially with no fees.


The products are listed on Cboe Options Exchange (C1), one of Cboe's SEC-registered securities exchanges. To clear the products, Cboe Clear U.S., LLC (CCUS), received temporary registration from the SEC as a clearing agency, making it subject to the SEC's standards for Covered Clearing Agencies.


KPI binary options are the latest step in Cboe's plans to leverage its market expertise, trusted infrastructure and clearing capabilities to bring a broader set of innovative products to investors, including additional securities-based products, economic event and commodity contracts, and potentially tokenized binary security options.


To learn more, visit:[KPI Binary Options](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4830193-1&h=2901249386&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cboe.com%2Fmarkets%2Fprediction-markets%2Fkpi&a=KPI+Binary+Options) .


**About Cboe Global Markets**


Cboe Global Markets (Cboe: CBOE) is a leading global markets operator with a long history of innovation in equity and index derivatives. Since launching the world's first listed options exchange in 1973, Cboe has pioneered landmark products, including the introduction of S&P 500® index options and the creation of the VIX® Index, the world's leading gauge of market volatility, reshaping how investors manage risk and access opportunity. Today, Cboe operates derivatives, equities, and FX markets, providing trading, clearing, and investment solutions for customers worldwide.
